proposedEntry.name: wireframe
proposedEntry.description: Guides the agent to explore a design space quickly with many rough, structurally distinct low-fidelity wireframes rather than one polished direction. Directs producing 3-5 structurally different options per idea (not recolors), using sketchy hand-written fonts, mostly black-and-white shapes with sparing color accents, plain-language section labels, and a minimal tweak surface (variant toggle, density, optional-section swap), while explicitly avoiding polish, hover states, and visual convergence across options.
triggers: give me a few structurally different layouts
inputs: an existing product/problem context to riff on
outputs: a set of 3-5 structurally distinct low-fidelity HTML wireframes laid out for side-by-side comparison, with plain-language section labels and interaction annotations

#### manalkaff/opendesign — skills/wireframe (inspected 2026-08-29)
- HEAD commit (default branch `main`): `cecd9bb6b59408cb96a3974449b8e6ef9f5b17bb` (resolved via https://github.com/manalkaff/opendesign/commits/main.atom after api.github.com hit the unauthenticated rate limit; corroborated by WebFetch of the repo page showing MIT license, ~255 stars, 24 commits on main).
- Repo has 10 skill directories under `skills/`: create-design-system, frontend-design, handoff-to-claude-code, interactive-prototype, make-a-deck, make-tweakable, opendesign, run-opendesign, setup-opendesign, wireframe. Full tree listed via `codeload.github.com/.../tar.gz/<sha>` + `tar -tzf`; every SKILL.md in all 10 read in full at the pinned SHA (extracted from the tarball). Per brief, vendoring at most 4 design-relevant ones; the other 6 are recorded in `opendesign-rejections.json`.
- `wireframe` (this manifest): SKILL.md only, 2 fields of frontmatter (name, description) — a strict subset of the six spec fields, so `claude-ai` is appended to compatibility. name=wireframe matches dirname. No relative links to any other file — fully self-contained. Only external-facing convention is the output path `./opendesign/mockups/<task-slug>/`, which is advisory, not a hard functional dependency.
- LICENSE: read repo-root `LICENSE` in full — genuine MIT text with `Copyright (c) 2026 manalkaff`.
- Security: no scripts, no network calls, no credential access, no hidden instructions.
- Rubric: relevance 3 (wireframing is a core interaction-design activity), quality 3 (concrete quantity/spread rule — "if two wireframes could be swapped by changing a class, they are the same wireframe" — plus explicit visual-style and structure rules and an explicit anti-convergence check), conformance 2 (clean spec-minimal frontmatter, no broken links, no hard host coupling), uniqueness 2 (the registry has a `prototype` skill but nothing dedicated to rapid multi-option low-fidelity wireframe divergence). Total 10. Verdict: vendor.
